blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Riverside
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: Downtown Riverside's Market Street corridor and the Fox Theatre have almost no large parking lot, so coach drop-and-go is the norm.
UC Riverside's campus events and the downtown venues sit on opposite sides of the city, so shuttling between them saves an hour of parking.
The metro area spills across I-10, I-215, SR 60 and SR 91, and interchanges stop moving at peak hours.
SNA and Ontario Intl are both roughly 25-30 miles away, while BUR is the nearest general-aviation option.

blocks.text: We also quote Riverside to the hour rather than the trip. Most groups need four hours, and four is the standard minimum across the industry because a committed vehicle cannot be sold to anyone else while it is parked at your venue. If your night genuinely needs less, ask for a one-way transfer rate instead of paying a full minimum.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Riverside Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

blocks.text: Licensed, Insured, and Backup Plans

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed and background checked, and our vehicles are licensed and inspected. Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.
